newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's NLCF buys 87,500 tonnes of Chinese corn.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's NLCF buys 87,500 tonnes of Chinese corn.

text.p: South Korea's National Livestock Cooperatives Federation (NLCF) said on Thursday it bought 30,000 tonnes of Chinese corn from Louis Dreyfus and 57,500 tonnes of Chinese corn from Cargill.
An NLCF official said it also passed on tenders for 52,500 tonnes of feed wheat due to high offer prices.
Arrival for the passed feed wheat tender was set for two ports among Inchon, Ulsan, Kunsan and Pusan, the official said.
He said shipment for the wheat tender was scheduled for July 17-August 5 if from U.S. Gulf/Europe or for August 5-24 if from the Pacific Northwest/Canada/Australia.
The purchase prices were based on a cost and freight.
